import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[84]['confidence']['1']='low';a[84]['note']='Final glyph heavily worn; surviving outline appears to lack a leftward top flag.'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(items)
for x,y in zip(items,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(n) for n in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==expected and set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for y in a for v in y['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(a),'items;',sum(c.values()),'slots')
print({k:c[k] for k in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in a))
